policy: Routes listed here were topically foreign to the vertical whose path they occupied. They have been retired under PAGE_RELEASE_LAW as ACTIVE_301 redirects to the correct vertical hub, recorded in data/release/route_retirements.json and _redirects. They are no longer admitted, no longer in any sitemap, and no longer in the frozen page registry. Retirement is not deletion: the rendered pages remain on disk and the retirement can be reversed.

mechanism.summary: A four-regex text classifier whose default branch returns 'pi' overwrote the correct vertical that each signal already carried, and a capacity-driven fallback then published whatever the vertical field said.

classifier.detail: verticalFor(text) tests four regexes against the question text and returns 'pi' when none match. Line 14 sets vertical: verticalFor(n.normalized_query || n.preserved_query), discarding n.vertical and n.target_vertical, which are present and correct on every normalized signal. The same object never copies n.cluster, which is why all four routes have no cluster.
classifier.verified: For all four routes the normalized signal carried the correct vertical (neuro, trt, uscis, dentistry) and cluster 'state-specific'; each question misses all four regexes and fell to the default.

publisher.detail: socialFallbackRecords() stamps admission_basis SOCIAL_BACKLOG_APPROVED_FALLBACK and tops up the release batch to TARGET from the social backlog, filtered only on query length and vertical membership. 'personal_injury' is on that whitelist, so a row mislabelled 'pi' by the classifier is automatically eligible. Selection is by priority_score (signal_score * 10), which has no topical component.

why_the_gate_did_not_catch_them.detail: The topic-fit gate rejects all four titles when run today. These pages carry velocity_only_program AUTOMATIC_PUBLIC_SIGNAL_RELEASE, a tag no current script writes, so they were published by a predecessor releaser that ran before the gate existed. Nothing re-evaluates already-live pages, so the gate was never applied retroactively.

orphan_status_note: These four routes have zero inbound internal links. That is the correct outcome and this file exists to keep it correct: buildLinkCoveragePlan in scripts/build_site.js reads this list and refuses to adopt these routes onto a host, so a future rebuild that thaws their would-be hosts cannot quietly link them.
